title: colander rules schema
description: Base template for the rules document colander compiles and evaluates (docs/documents.md#rules-schema, docs/rules.md). Uses only keywords from the subset colander itself implements (docs/json-schema.md, SPEC S-1..S-7), with local #/$defs references only, so this file also works when passed to colander_validate_schema.

formSchemaVersion.description: Must equal the form's schemaVersion when both are present, else RULE_SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH.

fields.description: Keyed by field id. A key that is not a form field id is a hard RULE_UNKNOWN_FIELD error. Non-object entries are silently skipped.

anyOf.description: Any non-object value is tolerated and ignored by analysis.

fieldRules.description: Per-field rules. Each key is a null-or-expression; null and absent are the same. Unknown keys are preserved by compile but ignored by analysis.

calculate.description: Runs in topological dependency order before predicates. The field must be readOnly (RULE_CALCULATE_NOT_READONLY) and must not reference its own code (RULE_SELF_REFERENCE).

validation.description: One cross-field check. Reports its error when assert is present, non-null and falsy; when, when present, guards the entry (SPEC R-3).

code.description: Required string, unique across the array (RULE_DUPLICATE_VALIDATION_CODE).

when.description: Optional guard; absent or null means the entry always runs.

assert.description: Required: an entry with no assert is rejected with RULE_MISSING_ASSERT (SPEC R-4).

message.description: Optional; defaults to Validation failed. when reported.

expression.description: A rule expression. A node with a non-empty ref is a reference and nothing else is read from it; otherwise a lit wins over op, even when the literal is null. An op node requires args.

ref.description: The current value of a field, addressed by code and null when unknown. An empty ref falls through to lit/op.

lit.description: A literal: any JSON value, including null.

op.description: The fixed operator set (SPEC R-1) plus the repeater aggregates count(code) and sum(code, childCode) (SPEC R-7). Anything else is Unsupported expression operator.

args.description: Operand expressions. Binary operators take at least two (extras are evaluated, then ignored); and/or/coalesce take any number, including none.
